employer job pages on Greenhouse, Recruitee, Workable, PeopleForce and Teamtailor

method.filtering_summary: Of about 2,750 postings pulled, about 280 were more than 30 days old, about 1,150 had senior, lead or manager titles, about 890 weren’t target roles, and about 130 were limited to regions that exclude Kenya. Most of the roughly 300 left failed on a closer read, usually on years of experience or a location rule in the posting itself.

stories.title: JetBrains releases Mellum2.1 for coding agents
stories.summary: 12B MoE model with 2.5B active parameters under Apache 2.0; post-trained with reinforcement learning in real sandboxes so it can explore a repo, edit files and check its own changes.
stories.why: A fast, self-hostable coding-agent model he could try in local agent workflows.

stories.title: Liquid AI releases open-weight d1 decision models
stories.summary: d1-3B and d1-omni-600M are on Hugging Face; d1-3B answers in 8 ms on an RTX 4090 and produces an answer in a single forward pass instead of tokens.
stories.why: Small, fast models suit cheap on-device routing and classification steps in agent pipelines.

stories.title: Anthropic launches critical-infrastructure cyber program and free OSS Scanner
stories.summary: Partners include Accenture, CrowdStrike and Palo Alto; OSS Scanner gives eligible open-source projects free periodic vulnerability scans from Anthropic’s strongest models.
stories.why: Shows how frontier models are being used for security tooling, adjacent to agent and automation work.

stories.title: LiteLLM open-sources Moyai, a self-hosted cloud coding agent
stories.summary: Runs Claude Code or Codex on 100+ providers; LiteLLM says it would have cost about $21,700 against a $101,872 monthly Devin bill.
stories.why: A concrete, self-hostable example of background coding agents he could study or run.

stories.title: YC-backed Bujeti launches Brain AI teammates for African finance teams
stories.summary: Four agents (Fetch, Chaser, Watchdog, Concierge) are live for more than 2,000 finance users in Nigeria and Kenya; Bujeti is also building an MCP connector for Claude and ChatGPT.
stories.why: African fintech agent tooling with MCP plans sits next to his Kwara automation work.

stories.title: Kenyan fintech Cloud9 hits $1m funding with Alliance
stories.summary: Alliance’s investment brings total funding to $1 million for cross-border payments, cards and multi-currency accounts; Cloud9 says more than 25,000 accounts have opened since early 2026.
stories.why: A Nairobi-facing payments startup raising money is a nearby hiring signal for fintech engineers.

stories.title: Nous Research raises $90M at a $1.5B valuation
stories.summary: Series B led by Robot Ventures (Nvidia, USV, Menlo among backers); total funding $158 million; launching "Hermes for Businesses" agents.
stories.why: A well-funded open-source agent company moving into enterprise, likely hiring agent engineers.

stories.title: HubSpot cuts nearly 660 jobs, about 7% of staff
stories.summary: 8-K dated Oct 6 estimates $65–75 million in charges; CEO Yamini Rangan said the cut is not driven by AI efficiencies and aims for fewer management layers.
stories.why: Another mid-size SaaS round of cuts that adds experienced people to the remote hiring pool.

stories.title: Amazon confirms hundreds of retail job cuts
stories.summary: Cuts mainly in Stores (customer service, selling-partner support and retail engineering); outlets report fewer than 1,000 white-collar roles, with staff in the US, India and the UK affected.
stories.why: Big-tech cuts keep adding experienced people to the remote job pool.

stories.title: KRA to use eTIMS stock records against tax returns
stories.summary: A September KRA notice requires TIMS/eTIMS users to keep purchase, sale, transfer and disposal stock records that the authority can compare with electronic invoices.
stories.why: Tighter electronic tax trails mean more integration and compliance tooling work for Kenyan fintechs.

stories.title: Equity's Finserve pilots Emma, a new mobile money wallet
stories.summary: Pilot wallet on Google Play (100+ downloads) to send, receive, borrow, save and pay; sign-up in the app, via *765# or the Equitel SIM toolkit.
stories.why: A new M-PESA rival means more Kenyan wallet and payments integration work.
